CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Loss Function]
- What: In data_processing_and_feature_engineering, increase SASRec’s uniformly sampled training negatives from 16 to 64 per active sequence position; retain the existing sampled-softmax cross-entropy, rejection of training-history items, and positive target at column zero.
- Why: Each evaluated target competes against 99 negatives, whereas training currently provides only 16 competitors, potentially leaving SASRec insufficiently trained to distinguish moderately competitive items.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: Limited negative coverage is a plausible training bottleneck; the reported results do not establish which ensemble member causes Electronics’ weakness.
- Evidence: The supplied equal-fusion ensemble reaches macro HR@10=0.5637 but Electronics reaches only 0.345 versus the original baseline’s 0.420, while category-specific fusion tuning subsequently lowers the aggregate to 0.5625.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Sampling 64 negatives increases exposure to competitive distractors and improves the sampled approximation to catalog-wide softmax without adding an expert or tuning fusion weights.
- Expected improvement: Hypothesize a modest macro HR@10 increase over 0.5637; accept the change only on independently measured host validation, and report per-category results without assuming Electronics will improve.
- Validation: In training_evaluation, retain identical checkpoint selection and deployed scoring, print the actual four-category macro as Final Validation Score, and log completed updates and elapsed time to expose any throughput cost under unchanged deadlines.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: preprocessing=0; training=42; validation sampling=42.
- Data split: identical supplied training and validation splits; no hidden test access.
- All four categories, dataset routing, and DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'].
- SASRec architecture and preference gate, MultVAE architecture and training, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, dropout, sequence length, and positive targets.
- Parent equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion with constant 60; do not incorporate the unsuccessful category-weight search.
- Existing epoch limits, SASREC_EPOCHS default 200, early stopping, category deadlines, trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, and shared search budget.
- Validation uses 200 users/category and 99 unique negatives with HR@10; working/predict.py continues loading the trained experts and using the same scoring helper as validation.
- Held-out prediction and final evaluation remain the host’s responsibility; do not read hidden files or fabricate a submission.csv.
